measurement_method: All five actual source images visually inspected using view_image; card/control/decorations rectangles measured in source pixels, Chinese OCR bounds transformed from atlas by subtracting each actual crop origin. Colors sampled using Pillow. Bounds are manual visual measurements, typically within 2–4 source pixels.
rules: Every label/button/status/timeline/service icon and desktop icon must be a native Makepad component or drawing
Only the technician portrait in frame 10 may be a bitmap asset; no UI screenshot underlay
Raw OCR observations retained with stable atlas indices; known glyph artifacts explicitly corrected or excluded
Native component implementation can normalize source-generation spacing/icons, but preserve service ownership and separate actions
